programs.description: Amit and Asha love each other, but the latter's father wants her to get married to an NRI. Hoping for a better future, the couple decides to enter America illegally.
Wealthy Vikram, overprotected Siddharth and ambitious orphan Aayush join a prestigious hostel. Facing fresh challenges, the trio strives to earn a coveted spot on the wall of fame.
The host, Jay Raval, engages in an insightful conversation with eminent Gujarati folk singer, Divya Chaudhary, who shares her musical journey.

After the final evening of celebration, everyone returns to work. It's revealed that Aadarsh, Aakash's elder brother, made a bold sacrifice to save him—one that ends in failure and changes everything.
Aadarsh, trying to recover money lost over forced alcohol purchases, attempts to control the chaos. As he makes compromises, the group spirals into confusion and disappointment.
As debts pile up and Salim Bhai's pressure mounts, the group rethinks their choices. After paying off most dues, they plan a trip, hoping to escape the chaos of recent weeks.
The friends must understand soon that the challenging task will destroy their lives.
Parbhavni Preet explores a love that defies death. With Naresh Kanodiya and Firoz Irani, this tale journeys through lifetimes, where passion, vengeance, and destiny collide in an eternal love story.
